Customs Tariff Amendment (Fuel Indexation) Bill 2014 and related bills - Second Reading - Read a second time

Moved a debate management motion limiting consideration of the four fuel indexation bills to a set process, including capping the detail stage at 30 minutes, to ensure the government's fuel excise legislation passes that day.

Supported the Customs Tariff Amendment (Fuel Indexation) Bill 2014, projected to raise about $2.2 billion for road infrastructure, and highlighted a $50 million joint Commonwealth-New South Wales commitment to build the 4.6 kilometre Queanbeyan bypass.
